concerns.text: SC‑001 requires computing the proportion of lags whose 95 % confidence interval contains zero, but no task in tasks.md generates or records this metric.
The implementation plan references task T012 (sensitivity timeout) which does not exist in tasks.md, leaving a dangling reference.
The plan also references task T017 (orchestrator) which is absent; the orchestrator functionality is now provided by task T031, so the plan should be updated to use the correct task identifier.
